from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single provided paper and its citation relations within the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as published")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that are referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all papers found in the provided collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
